description: This Java class represents the domain model for a savings account charge in the Apache Fineract system. It encapsulates the properties, creation logic, and behavior of charges associated with savings accounts, such as fees, penalties, due dates, calculation types, and payment states. The class includes methods for managing charge payments, waivers, resets, and scheduling of recurring charges.

classes.name: SavingsAccountCharge
classes.description: Domain entity representing a charge associated with a savings account, including details such as charge type, amount, due date, payment status, and recurrence logic.

methods.name: createNewFromJson
methods.description: Factory method to create a new SavingsAccountCharge instance from JSON input, associating it with a savings account and charge definition.

methods.name: createNewWithoutSavingsAccount
methods.description: Creates a new SavingsAccountCharge instance without associating it with a specific savings account, mainly for internal or temporary use.

methods.name: resetPropertiesForRecurringFees
methods.description: Resets properties for charges that recur periodically, such as monthly, annual, or weekly fees, resetting paid status and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: markAsFullyPaid
methods.description: Marks the charge as fully paid by setting amountPaid to the total amount and outstanding to zero.

methods.name: resetToOriginal
methods.description: Resets charge details to their original pending state, preparing for a retry or recalculation.

methods.name: undoPayment
methods.description: Reverses a payment made towards this charge, adjusting paid and outstanding amounts appropriately.

methods.name: waive
methods.description: Applies a waiver to the charge, reducing or eliminating the amount outstanding.

methods.name: undoWaiver
methods.description: Reverses a waiver applied to the charge, restoring the amount owed.

methods.name: pay
methods.description: Records a payment against the charge, adjusting paid and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates charge details such as amount, due date, and fee scheduling.

methods.name: calculateOutstanding
methods.description: Calculates how much remains unpaid on the charge, considering payments, waivers, and write-offs.

methods.name: amount
methods.description: Returns the charge amount as BigDecimal.

methods.name: amoutOutstanding
methods.description: Returns the current outstanding amount on the charge (note: typo in method name).

methods.name: isFeeCharge
methods.description: Indicates whether this charge is a fee (not a penalty).

methods.name: isPenaltyCharge
methods.description: Indicates whether this charge is a penalty.

methods.name: isNotFullyPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge is not fully paid.

methods.name: isPaid
methods.description: Indicates whether the charge has been paid in full.

methods.name: isWaived
methods.description: Indicates whether the charge has been waived.

methods.name: isPaidOrPartiallyPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge has any payment or waiver applied, i.e., not fully unpaid.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount as a Money object for a given currency.

methods.name: getAmountPaid
methods.description: Returns the amount paid as a Money object for a given currency.

methods.name: getAmountWaived
methods.description: Returns the waived amount as a Money object.

methods.name: getAmountWrittenOff
methods.description: Returns the amount written off as a Money object.

methods.name: getAmountOutstanding
methods.description: Returns the remaining outstanding amount as a Money object.

methods.name: updatePaidAmountBy
methods.description: Increments the paid amount by a given Money value and adjusts outstanding accordingly.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the charge (from the associated Charge entity).

methods.name: currencyCode
methods.description: Returns the currency code associated with the charge.

methods.name: getCharge
methods.description: Returns the underlying Charge definition object.

methods.name: savingsAccount
methods.description: Returns the associated SavingsAccount object.

methods.name: isOnSpecifiedDueDate
methods.description: Checks if the charge is scheduled for a specific due date.

methods.name: isSavingsActivation
methods.description: Checks if the charge is for savings account activation.

methods.name: isSavingsNoActivity
methods.description: Checks if the charge is for savings account no activity fee.

methods.name: isSavingsClosure
methods.description: Checks if the charge is for savings account closure.

methods.name: isWithdrawalFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is a withdrawal fee.

methods.name: isOverdraftFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is an overdraft fee.

methods.name: isAnnualFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is an annual fee.

methods.name: isMonthlyFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is a monthly fee.

methods.name: isWeeklyFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is a weekly fee.

methods.name: hasCurrencyCodeOf
methods.description: Checks if the charge's currency code matches a specified code.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare SavingsAccountCharge instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode for the SavingsAccountCharge entity.

methods.name: calculateWithdralFeeAmount
methods.description: Calculates the withdrawal fee amount based on the transaction amount.

methods.name: updateWithdralFeeAmount
methods.description: Updates the outstanding amount with a new withdrawal fee calculation.

methods.name: updateNoWithdrawalFee
methods.description: Sets the outstanding amount to zero, removing withdrawal fee.

methods.name: updateToNextDueDateFrom
methods.description: Advances the due date to the next recurrence based on scheduling.

methods.name: getNextDueDateFrom
methods.description: Calculates the next due date from a starting date considering fee schedule.

methods.name: calculateNextDueDate
methods.description: Computes the subsequent due date based on fee schedule (monthly, yearly, weekly).

methods.name: setDayOfMonth
methods.description: Adjusts the date to a specific day of the month for dues.

methods.name: setDayOfWeek
methods.description: Adjusts the date to a specific day of the week for dues.

methods.name: updateToPreviousDueDate
methods.description: Reverts the due date to the previous schedule based on recurrence.
